description: Launch gates for RideShare (issue #18). Source of truth for what must be approved before the product is anything more than a demo or pilot. Read by web/src/lib/launch.test.ts. A gate is approved only with an accountable owner, evidence, an approver and a date. LAUNCH_STAGE in web/src/lib/launch.ts must stay 'pilot' until every critical gate is approved.

gates.title: Insurance covers rides, riders, drivers and the platform
gates.why: Real people are carried in real vehicles. Which cover applies (driver personal, commercial, per-trip, platform liability) depends on place and arrangement.
gates.evidenceRequired: Policy documents or broker confirmation for each place and vehicle use, with limits, named insured and dates; who is notified of a claim.
gates.builtInRepo: Nothing. The app does not hold or check insurance.

gates.title: Local transport rules are satisfied in every place of operation
gates.why: Many places license ride-hailing operators, vehicles and drivers, and restrict fares, areas or vehicle types.
gates.evidenceRequired: A written determination by someone qualified for each place: licences required, held or not needed, conditions, and the places the service may operate. The app is limited to those places.
gates.builtInRepo: Nothing. The app does not restrict by place.

gates.title: Driver screening is defined, run and recorded
gates.why: Approval today checks only that a licence number, region, expiry and a vehicle were supplied and a staff member approved. No background, identity, licence or vehicle-inspection check is made.
gates.evidenceRequired: The screening standard (identity, licence verification, criminal and driving record, vehicle inspection, re-check interval) per place, who performs it, and a sample record for each approved driver.
gates.builtInRepo: Driver application and staff approval workflow (#4); suspension (#12). Not the checks themselves.

gates.title: Tax treatment of fares, fees and payouts is decided and set up
gates.why: ADR 0001 left the tax rate, who collects and remits it, and driver tax reporting undecided. The ledger records a rate of zero.
gates.evidenceRequired: An accountant's or adviser's written treatment per place: rates, who is liable, registrations, invoice and receipt wording, driver reporting duties; the policy version set in the ledger.
gates.builtInRepo: Immutable fare ledger and receipts (#9). No money is collected or paid out.

gates.title: Money movement is approved, or the pilot is confirmed free of it
gates.why: No payment is collected and no driver is paid (ADR 0001). The platform rule against in-app payments needs an explicit decision before real fares exist.
gates.evidenceRequired: Either the platform's written decision and a provider integration with refunds and disputes tested, or a recorded decision that the pilot charges nothing and what riders and drivers are told.
gates.builtInRepo: Ledger, receipts and refund-request records (#9, #11). Executing refunds waits on payments.

gates.title: Terms of service for riders and drivers are written, reviewed and shown
gates.why: The app contains no terms and asks nobody to accept any.
gates.evidenceRequired: The reviewed terms text for riders and for drivers, the version identifier, where and when each person accepts, and where acceptance is recorded.
gates.builtInRepo: Nothing. There is no terms screen or acceptance record.

gates.title: The privacy notice and every open privacy decision are approved
gates.why: docs/privacy.md lists decisions that are legal choices and were left open: retention of audit and financial records, subject-access scope, jurisdiction, age, inactive accounts.
gates.evidenceRequired: The published privacy notice, and for each "needs a human decision" item in docs/privacy.md and docs/safety.md a recorded decision or an accepted risk; the data-protection contact.
gates.builtInRepo: Inventory, consent, retention, export and erasure (#13). Every open item is marked needs-human.

gates.title: Safety policy, emergency wording and escalation are approved
gates.why: The emergency guidance is deliberately jurisdiction-neutral and has not been reviewed for any place. Nothing pages anyone for an urgent report.
gates.evidenceRequired: Review of SAFETY_COPY for each place; the out-of-hours arrangement (who watches the Safety tab and when); the rule for referring reports to authorities; the appeal route for blocks and suspensions.
gates.builtInRepo: Safety button, reports, escalation, blocks and runbook (#12). Alert after 5 minutes.

gates.title: Support coverage, hours and contact are in place
gates.why: Riders and drivers need a way to reach a person, and staff need to be present while rides run. The app has no support contact or hours.
gates.evidenceRequired: Named staff with roles (ops, ops_pii), hours of cover matched to the hours rides are allowed, the support contact shown to users, and a dry run of the safety incident runbook.

gates.title: Staff are trained and the runbooks have been rehearsed
gates.why: Runbooks exist but nobody has used them under pressure.
gates.evidenceRequired: A record of a rehearsal for dispatch outage, rollback and safety incident, who took part, what was fixed afterwards.

gates.title: The live end-to-end matrix is running and green after deploys
gates.why: The matrix needs four test accounts that do not exist yet.
gates.evidenceRequired: The PAS_E2E_* secrets set, a green run of every journey (including the slow one) on the deployed app, and who is told when it fails.

gates.title: Accessibility and mobile checklist run on real devices
gates.why: Automated checks pass; nobody has used the app with VoiceOver or TalkBack.
gates.evidenceRequired: The completed manual checklist in docs/accessibility.md with device, OS and date, and the issues found.

gates.title: Rollback and rider/driver communication plan is approved and rehearsed
gates.why: docs/launch.md documents the steps and draft messages; nobody has approved the wording or confirmed the channels reach people.
gates.evidenceRequired: Approved message texts, the channels actually available, who sends, and a rehearsal of pausing dispatch and returning to pilot.
gates.builtInRepo: Dispatch pause, rollback runbook, pilot limit (this issue).

gates.title: Incident ownership and regulator/press contact are named
gates.why: Someone must own an incident, decide what to tell people and deal with a regulator or the press.
gates.evidenceRequired: The incident owner and deputy, the contact for regulators and press, and the escalation order.
gates.builtInRepo: Escalation levels lead, safety and legal in the console (#11).
